Gideon's 1 July post in #strategic-pod says he closed out **ticket #8841** with support. The fix, in his words, was that the customer's IT cleared a **browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets**, after which the standard template worked for their billing team.

Other notes in the workspace describe #8841 differently (a gate kiosk timeout at Allentown, and a carrier portal problem at Newark), so I'd check the ticket record itself before quoting it in the QBR deck. I can't see the ticket system from here.
